# MM-P1-L1-IH03 - Maintenance manual - Hot Forge induction billet heater #3

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-IH03

Scope
- This document covers routine maintenance and verification steps for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03). Tasks address mechanical inspection, cooling system verification, and temperature control checks required to maintain process readiness.

Tools
- Torque wrench set appropriate for manufacturer fasteners.
- Digital infrared pyrometer or contact thermocouple calibrated for process use.
- Flow meter capable of verifying coil cooling water flow.
- Insulation-resistant gloves and eye protection.
- Lockout-tagout kit and multimeter for electrical isolation verification.

Procedure
- Verify equipment is placed into maintenance lockout in accordance with SOP-P1-L1-01 before any work on EQ-P1-L1-IH03. Confirm electrical isolation and test for zero energy.
- Visually inspect coil assembly, bus connections, and water lines for leaks, wear, and securing hardware. Repair or replace per OEM guidance.
- Restart cooling water to the coil and use the flow meter to confirm coil cooling water flow meets the coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 72 L/min. Do not proceed if flow is below this value; rectify leaks, filter restrictions, or pump issues.
- Power unit under maintenance-mode procedures from SOP-P1-L1-01 and bring to idle according to control interface. Using the pyrometer or thermocouple, heat a dummy billet and monitor temperature until the target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 1180 °C. Verify stability and repeatability of temperature control.
- Re-secure all covers and verify electrical connections meet insulation and fastening requirements per SB-1009. Remove lockout when maintenance is complete and document actions.

Acceptance criteria
- Coil cooling water flow is confirmed at or above 72 L/min.
- Temperature control achieves and maintains 1180 °C on the billet within control tolerances.
- No fluid leaks, loose connections, or safety impediments remain; all work documented in MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3 and SOP-P1-L1-01.
